## 9. Verification parity (30 headless sim scenarios must pass)
- boot + title -> play
- random play 2 minutes (field)
- camp is fully safe (20 s standing at the fence gap)
- boss fight (gate open, sword Lv4, armor Lv2)
- economy: bank + shop flows
- world pauses cleanly while a dialog is open
- in-flight bone vs player standing just inside the camp gap
- rest needs REST_DELAY seconds of stillness before healing
- death respawns with reduced HP and MP
- market: bounded random price, sentiment drives multipliers
- forge: craft with materials, reject on insufficient
- pool: deposit safe on death, withdraw with yield
- new enemies spawn and drop materials
- death loses all materials
- map: 4-6 fishing ponds, one near (outside) the camp
- fishing: F at a pond -> RAW FISH in bag + fishing XP
- fishing: getting hit snaps the line, moving cancels, no water = no fishing
- enemy pressure: field population and spawn timer
- fishing review fixes (D-017): tiers, facing, moving, reachable ponds, ninja turf
- rest caps HP at 60% while MP fills to max
- inventory: I/Tab open it, 12 slots, food stacks of 5, materials shown
- food: RAW +15, COOKED +25, cook only near the fire
- skills grow only by use: combat on hit, bark per cast, tier bonus on damage
- death empties the bag (carried food), keeps pooled DOGE
- partner NPCs: Cloverheart (Relotto), Noah, Bitget Wallet Card tell their story and open their links
- faction trainers: pick a class locally, its mechanic applies, one class at a time (D-028)
- class skills: GROUND POUND knocks back, QUICK SHOT flies fast, MEND spends MP to heal (D-029)
- Sphinx = DogeOS DeFi hub: connect, market, faucet, stake, oracle, school, dogeos.com, docs
- Elder = Keeper of the Heist: story, factions, join, heist.dogeos.com
